description: A cut-off mark is a minimum mark scored by the candidates to enter the counselling at the institution, however, the cut-off mark has two sets, qualifying cut-off and admission cut-off. Generally, National Testing Agency (NTA) conducts Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Advanced for admission to IITs and ISM comprises the subjects of Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics in two papers, JEE Advanced Paper 1 and Paper
